name: Thurston Waffles
knownFor: The loudest meow on the internet
bio: Thurston Waffles does not meow; he detonates. His air-raid-siren yowl — usually deployed at the bathroom door — became the acapella track for a thousand techno remixes. Sound engineers study him. Neighbors fear him. He just wants the door opened, and he wants it opened operatically.
awards: Most remixed meow in recorded history (2019, unofficial)
